pr_before_final_delivery.body:
MCP handlers can hide unsafe filesystem, process-option, URL and credential flows behind helpers, factories, clients and middleware. This integration follows supported source bindings, adds SENT-014–016, expands workspace/registration coverage, and keeps unresolved flows explicit. It builds on the containment and description-poisoning parent increments.

The fetch-mcp correction follows genuine schema field flow and async static helpers, then distinguishes an enforced private-IPv4 hostname check from a whole-URL check or escaped/replaced URL object. Both exposed SSRF families now pass two five-input native runs: 2/2 correlated vulnerable condition hits and zero matching fixed/control alerts per family. Fixed fetch-mcp reports retain scoped residual uncertainty; original frozen misses and source assessments are preserved. These are exposed regressions, not fresh accuracy results.

Python credential analysis reuses pure guard aggregates for unchanged immutable environment snapshots. Failed cache experiments and their reversions remain in history/evidence. Focused timing gains do not establish reliability: final local development completes 22/25, with three Meta operator-fallback timeouts. All ten vulnerable conditions are detected; 12/13 valid negatives complete without matching alerts. The separately authorized final Linux sequence retains the original development 25 → historical 45 → historical 45 gates and conditional stopping, with both 120-second deadlines and no retry or pooling.

Runtime campaigns preserve ordered attempts, fair scheduling, prerequisites and unstarted work. Native schema 1.7, migrations, console/SARIF and candidate-bound review retain coverage and observed proof; review context remains bounded to 160 source lines. Static analysis never executes targets; runtime targets use Sentinel-controlled Docker.

Measured scanner: **7555a9d3b472516ea880bd0ba8fbd25e89699453**. Workflow delivery: **a4766a99843451357d68db7d4aba2c122da5b4b9**, with identical scanner/test/package inputs. Local suite: **2,140 passed, 36 skipped, 89.64% branch coverage**. Lint/format/typing, schemas/lock, dependency audit/notices, offline artifacts, strict docs and source-verified wheel/sdist installation smoke pass. Current production capture replay completes 20/20 Docker attempts with 14 findings and no new model calls. The 13 compatible Git campaigns remain incomplete: 312 tested, 728 remaining; no completed Git coverage claim.

Original held-out results remain 10 completed/10 unsupported/5 incomplete, with 0/4 completed vulnerable hits out of 10 vulnerable inputs. The new SearXNG five-input proposal is frozen after scanner stabilization and awaits exact user approval before evaluation. Source exposure is disclosed. No new-source scan has run.

[Current status](https://github.com/BashaarJavaid/MCP-Sentinel/blob/phase22/integration/docs/phase22-implementation-status.md) and [evidence/restore index](https://github.com/BashaarJavaid/MCP-Sentinel/blob/phase22/integration/artifacts/phase22/integration/README.md) retain all 86 requirements plus R87/R88, original failures, and sealed batches 1–38. Final hosted and Linux outcomes are pending. Phase 22 remains incomplete; final human acceptance has not been requested. The 396-request paid benchmark and pilots remain user-deferred, Phase 21 incomplete, and Phase 24/15 unchanged. No merge, release, outreach or next phase.
